name: Capture Webscraper
description: A polite single-site mirror (CLI): fetch one site's pages (and, with --media, its own media), obey its robots.txt and a per-host rate limit, write a .provenance.json beside every fetched file, convert pages to Markdown, and index the corpora in scrapes/INDEX.json. Also the apk_webscraper package that CAPTURE.crawler's Web Crawler tab calls.
